CommunityApplications.Profile:
**Wordly** by jakeshake: a self-hosted collection of daily word games for your household or friends.
- **Wordly**: guess the hidden 5 or 6 letter word in six or seven tries. - **Spelly Bee**: make as many words as you can from seven letters. - **Boxy Letters**: chain words around a square to use all twelve letters. - **Connecty**: sort sixteen words into four hidden groups.
Everyone on your server gets the same daily puzzles, with shared leaderboards, a practice mode, and 19 themes. Support and bug reports: open an issue on GitHub.
